positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Executed countermeasures to remediate vulnerabilities such as Shai Hulud by running cybersecurity team scripts to scan and detect exposure across our own Github Repos from the VA. 
● Trained and onboarded new team members on API functionality, deployment pipelines, troubleshooting methods, and incident response practices.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Developed automated Slack reporting via Python/Bash scripts using AWS query results and webhooks, improving API performance 
visibility and failure tracking. 
● Engineered and maintained high-demand REST APIs using Java Spring Boot, handling over 2–3 million requests weekly, monitored 
through Kibana and AWS CloudWatch. 
● Integrated a new REST call for our service that checks for Veteran’s eligibility after the PACT Act was passed, enabling veterans to 
see their eligibility after Agent Orange Exposure or after the Gulf War. 
● Utilized Jenkins to deploy and promote applications including resolving any application issues provided from console logs reporting 
failed deployments. 
● Migrated existing APIs onto ArgoCD with a repo managing all of our APIs Helm Charts and managing all secrets on HashiCorp 
Vault, with the use of GitHub Workflows to do builds and promotions of our applications. After deployments are done the data is then 
monitored using Datadog to make sure there are no abnormalities in success/failure rates. 
● Used kubectl to interact with containers that we have deployed on ArgoCD to manage our apps. 
● Authored and maintained comprehensive deployment of ArgoCD, usage of scripting, and monitoring documentation in Confluence, 
ensuring team knowledge continuity.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Introduced new solutions like data tables using Cucumber framework to reduce manual labor on test cases from an Application 
Lifecycle Management tool to speed up testing and release to production, reducing test cycle time by 30%. 
● Utilized Karate framework to create BDD tests for REST APIs across Visa and Mastercard systems, improving coverage and response 
validation. 
● Maintained back-end code that dealt with Funds on Mastercard/Visa using Java and Spring Webflux ensuring 90%+ unit test coverage 
with JUnit. 
● Configurations done on YML files to separate data of region specific like data centers, PGP keys, etc. 
● Managed deployments with a lead in release management and deploy applications to higher environments all the way to production. 
Reported incidents of applications failing and reviewing applications deployed successfully. 
● Automated tracking of deployments by using API calls from Jules to give info on every application’s deployment status with the use 
of Reactive Spring. The goal was to reduce manual effort to track every single application’s deployment status. 
● Mentored 10+ junior developers and interns, fostering strong onboarding and development practices.

positions.title: Intern
positions.description:
● Specialize in developing high availability REST services and integration between mobile applications and web applications, including 
other services oriented around geospatial imagery. 
● Provided integration for different applications and sensors in a microservices architecture using cloud and local specialized hardware 
for compute/storage.
